Subject: Finalizing orchestration call for production cutover and fallback owners

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. We want to lock a 60-minute orchestration call to walk through the final cutover plan, confirm fallback owners (both sides), and align on procurement/billing handoffs before your go-live.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue 2027-10-05, 09:00–10:00
- Tue 2027-10-05, 16:00–17:00
- Wed 2027-10-06, 08:00–09:00

Can you confirm which works best for you and Liam? I will include Aditya (SE) and Evelyn (Security) on the calendar. Attached is the mutual action plan and a draft agenda.

Draft agenda highlights:
- Rollout timeline and cutover minute-by-minute (owner callouts)
- Fallback & rollback decision tree + escalation path
- Security & evidence handoff (audit logs, retention)
- Procurement/billing and DocuSign timeline
- Post-cutover smoke tests and rollback window

Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can book the invite.

Thanks,

Hi all — thanks for the quick replies. 16:00–17:00 PDT on Tue 2027-10-05 works for the Redwood team; please consider that tentatively booked until Karthik sends the official invite.

Proposed 60-minute agenda (detailed):
1) 16:00–16:10 — Introductions & go/no-go criteria (Clearleaf + Redwood leads)
2) 16:10–16:25 — Cutover runbook walk-through (Aditya) — riskiest steps called out
3) 16:25–16:40 — Fallback & rollback decision tree (who hits the kill-switch, who owns DB restores)
4) 16:40–16:50 — Security evidence handoff (Evelyn) — logs, retention, audit timeline
5) 16:50–17:00 — Procurement and post-cutover billing / SOW sign-off items

Action items before call:
- Clearleaf: confirm on-call owners for rollback and DB restore + contact numbers (please reply in thread)
- Redwood: share prod-cutover-checklist.pdf and network egress checklist (attached)

Attachment: prod-cutover-checklist.pdf (summary of owner assignments and smoke test steps).

Thanks everyone — confirmed. I’ve sent a calendar invite to the attendees for Tue 2027-10-05, 16:00–17:00 PDT. Invite includes the draft agenda and links to the attachments in Drive.

Owner assignments (pre-call):
- Cutover lead (Redwood): Aditya Rao — will run the runbook and call go/no-go
- Rollback owner (Clearleaf): Maya Srinivasan — responsible for DB restore decision and initiating rollback steps
- Security evidence owner (Clearleaf): please confirm an email/contact; Evelyn will coordinate retrieval
- Billing/SOW (Clearleaf procurement): Liam O'Connor — will accept DocuSign flow and confirm billing start date

Fallback policy (brief):
- If primary cutover step fails and rollback is needed within the 2-hour window after cutover, Clearleaf initiates rollback and Redwood assists with DB dumps and data integrity checks.
- Escalation chain: Clearleaf oncall -> Clearleaf exec (Liam) -> Redwood SE (Aditya) -> Redwood EM on-call.
